dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello there. The pleasure is mine.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I am Katheryne, the receptionist of the Adventurers' Guild. My job is to provide the adventurers with quests and intelligence support.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: May my services be of help to you, and may your journey in Fontaine be a memorable one.
